children: Rafael Furst Discloses 6.0% Stake in Crypto Co

Rafael Furst, Crypto Co's chief strategy officer, reported beneficial ownership of 6.0% of the company's common stock. In a Schedule 13D filed Nov. 25, 2026, he reported 399.9 million shares, including shares held through Three Mile Creek Future LLC and a right for the LLC to acquire additional shares. Furst says he holds the shares for investment and participates in Crypto Co's strategic planning through his company role.

Furst says he acquired the shares for investment purposes. In his role at Crypto Co, he participates in the company's strategic planning, but the filing names no specific proposal, board change or operational plan.

Furst serves as Crypto Co's chief strategy officer. He is also a manager of Three Mile Creek Future LLC, an Ohio company whose principal business is investing. Furst and co-manager Laura Rose each have full authority to act for the LLC, which holds a substantial portion of his reported position.
